title: AI Chat Panel
description: Floating right-edge panel reachable from every authenticated route. Owns the SSE streaming chat pipeline (Ollama + Gemini providers), the four context layers (career-context slices, slash commands, @-mentions, ambient page refs), the assistant-only markdown renderer with Shiki-highlighted code blocks, and the three Phase-D code-block domain actions (Send to Worklog / Add to Job Notes / Save as Bullet) with a target-resolution picker. Authoritative ADRs: 0045 (envelope + provenance), 0046 (phases A through D — context slices, slash commands, @-mentions, code-block actions).

refreshHistory.summary: Seed slice. Authored immediately after ADR-0046 Phase D.3 landed (22215ce), so all 7 entryPoints reflect post-D.3 reality. Hand-authored — no analyzer mining yet.

Post-god-file-refactor refresh (phases 1–7, 34a0f5c). ai-chat.tsx 1026 → 281 LOC (−72%). Retired the god-file architectural trap. Added 5 hooks (use-ai-chat-{resize,models,context,stream,slash}.ts) + 6 sibling components (ai-chat-{empty-state,slash-menu,context-chips,settings-panel,message-list,toolbar}.tsx) to fileFingerprints. Behaviour preserved; vitest 966/971 baseline held across every phase.

ADR-0046 follow-up D — URL-aware ambient (48db823). Server now overrides the recency heuristic with userId-scoped /api/ai/context?activeWorklogId=&activeJobId= lookups when the client supplies pathname-derived hints. Client hook uses next/navigation usePathname + memoized parsePathnameForAmbient, refetches on every nav while open. New pure module src/lib/ai-chat-pathname.ts (13 TDD specs) + 3 new URL-override specs on the route. Allowlist v1: /worklog/notes/[id] → activeWorklogId, /experience/[id] → activeJobId (reserved /experience/verify skipped). Closes the cache-drift bug: chat opened on worklog A then nav to B no longer reports A. Pre-existing recency-heuristic isActive lookup is NOT userId-scoped — documented as a separate trap, out-of-scope for D.

ADR-0046 follow-up B — editor-aware send-to-worklog (commits 4b60788 / fb57906 / 6b06ddb). send-to-worklog now tries an in-page prepend before falling through to the legacy create-new POST. Retired the SHORT-CIRCUITS knownTrap on code-block-toolbar; replaced with the actual editor-registry-aware decision tree. Editor handle resolution lives in src/lib/worklog/editor-registry.ts (see worklog-editor slice for the registry entry point + the new traversal recipe how-does-ai-send-to-worklog-prepend-work). Live PUT smoke confirmed WorkLogVersion.source='ai-prepend' persists 2026-06-24T00:13:55Z (id 45d3e3b8).

entryPoints.name: Chat panel orchestrator
entryPoints.description: The slim 281-LOC `AIChat` client component (post-2026-06-23 god-file refactor). Owns ONLY: messages/input/showSettings/collapsedTurns/task/contextExpanded/mentions state, scrollRef/inputRef + focus/scroll effects, threadContext useMemo, clearChat + toggleTurnCollapsed callbacks, the 5 hook compositions, the handleSlashKey composer, and the JSX shell that wires the 6 sibling components. Domain logic lives in `src/hooks/use-ai-chat-*.ts`; presentation lives in `src/components/ai-chat-*.tsx`.
knownTraps: Decomposed god-file (2026-06-23, 1026 → 281 LOC, commit 34a0f5c). Architectural Guardrail: new behaviour goes in a sibling hook under `src/hooks/use-ai-chat-*.ts` or a sibling component under `src/components/ai-chat-*.tsx` — keep the orchestrator thin. Only plumbing-level edits (prop threading, new hook composition) belong in `ai-chat.tsx`.

Streaming hook contract (path B per Griller decision): `useAiChatStream` accepts `messages` + `setMessages` as params — it does NOT own the messages array. The hook keeps an internal `messagesRef` mirror (set on every render) so `sendMessage`'s dep array can drop `messages` and stay stable across SSE chunks. If you ever add a callback inside the hook that needs current messages, read from `messagesRef.current`, NEVER from the closure `messages`.

Toolbar dropdowns use base-ui `DropdownMenu`. `DropdownMenuItem` MUST use `onClick` not `onSelect` (Radix-only API, silently dropped); `DropdownMenuTrigger` MUST NOT pass `onClick` (clobbers base-ui's internal open handler — menu silently won't open). Both surfaces live inside `AIChatToolbar` and `AIChatSettingsPanel` now.

Slash command menu (extracted to `AIChatSlashMenu`) opens only when input `startsWith('/')` AND contains no whitespace — VS Code convention to avoid hijacking URLs typed mid-message. `slashIndex` resets via effect inside `useAiChatSlash` when filtered list shrinks below current index.

`Message.mentions` is the per-turn @-mention snapshot attached at send time (D.3) — used to build `ThreadContext.recentMentions` for the code-block resolver. The transient `mentions` state on the panel is the IN-PROGRESS buffer for the next turn, NOT a thread accumulator.

entryPoints.name: SSE chat route + envelope
entryPoints.description: POST `/api/ai/chat` accepts `{ messages, provider, model, localUrl, task, mentions }`, fans out to the Ollama or Gemini provider, and streams an SSE event sequence (`provider` → repeated `text` → final `meta`). The client `AIChat.sendMessage` reads the stream into the assistant message and hydrates `AIMeta` for the `AIProvenanceChip` (ADR-0045).
knownTraps: SSE event vocabulary is exactly three types: `provider` (early), `text` (repeated, append-only), `meta` (final, hydrates AIMeta). Adding a new type requires both the route emitter AND the `AIChat.sendMessage` switch.

Stop button works via `abortRef = new AbortController()` and `controller.abort()` on click. The `AbortError` branch in the catch is what swallows the resulting fetch rejection — don't re-throw or you'll surface a fake error in the message.
VS Code Copilot's Ollama bridge mangles tool-call tags from gemma4/qwen3-coder — NOT this route's fault. For local LLM tool use, route around Copilot via Cline (see user memory).

supergateway's MCP layer can return 503 `Single-client backing server already occupied` when VS Code holds an SSE while the worker restarts. Cleared by Command Palette → MCP: Restart Server (NOT by service restart).

entryPoints.name: Career context slices + ambient refs
entryPoints.description: GET `/api/ai/context` returns `{ slices, systemPrompt, ambient }`. Slices are server-curated chunks of the user's profile/position/skills/goals/etc. that the panel renders as removable chips above the input (ADR-0046 Phase A). The `ambient` field (Phase D.2, made URL-aware in follow-up D) exposes server-derived active entity refs the code-block action resolver consumes as precedence step (1). The route now accepts `?activeWorklogId=` and `?activeJobId=` query params; userId-scoped Prisma lookups for those ids OVERRIDE the recency heuristic when the row exists.
knownTraps: Legacy `systemPrompt` field is kept for back-compat with pre-slice-shape consumers; new client code must build the prompt from unsuppressed slices on the client side instead.

URL-aware ambient allowlist v1 (in `src/lib/ai-chat-pathname.ts`) is INTENTIONALLY narrow: only `/worklog/notes/[id]` (→ activeWorklogId) and `/experience/[id]` (→ activeJobId). Adding a surface requires a new regex + a new test — don't broaden silently or you'll surface ambient on routes the user doesn't perceive as 'job-scoped'.

Reserved subroute trap: `/experience/verify` is the Equifax verification page — NOT a WorkHistory detail. `RESERVED_EXPERIENCE_SEGMENTS` skips it. Every new `/experience/<reserved>` subroute MUST be added to that set.

URL-override is userId-scoped (`prisma.workHistory.findFirst({ where: { id, userId } })`). A foreign id silently falls through to the heuristic so the query-string surface never leaks data — keep this property if you ever refactor the parallel-fetch block.

Security invariant (patched 2026-06-24): both heuristic ambient reads and URL-override reads are userId-scoped in `/api/ai/context` (`workHistory.findFirst`, `workLog.findFirst`, and supporting slice queries). Keep all future ambient lookups owner-scoped to prevent cross-user leakage in multi-user deployments.
`ambient.activeJob` label: `"title @ company"` or just `company` when title is null. Don't change the format without checking `AIChatActionPicker` — the picker doesn't parse it, but humans read it.
`ambient.activeSkill` is reserved (always null in v1). No reliable server-side signal. The contract field exists so the chat panel + resolver compile against it.

Hook refetch contract: `useAiChatContext` now refetches on `[open, pathnameAmbient.activeWorklogId, pathnameAmbient.activeJobId]`. The old `contextSlices.length > 0` guard was REMOVED so navigation invalidates ambient. Slices re-arrive too but that's idempotent.
`usePathname` returns `null` during the first SSR render under app-router. `parsePathnameForAmbient(pathname ?? "")` defends against this — do not pass `pathname` directly.

entryPoints.name: @-mention textarea + search + ranking
entryPoints.description: `AIChatTextareaWithMentions` watches the caret for an `@` trigger and opens a picker that calls POST `/api/ai/mention-search` (forked from the editor variant — ranks by per-user EntityAIMentionCount instead of recency-in-note). Selected mentions become `MentionRef` anchors in the textarea AND ship in the chat-route sidecar so the server can increment counts AND inject a hidden system message with the JSON block.
knownTraps: Four mention types: `job` (WorkHistory), `skill` (SkillNode), `worklog` (WorkLog with kind='note'), `contact` (Contact). KEEP IN SYNC with the route validator's `VALID_TYPES` array — silently-dropped types are a real failure mode.

Orphan detection runs on every input change: a `MentionRef` whose `anchor` substring no longer appears in the textarea is dropped. Partial-label editing IS an orphan (anchor is the exact `@Label` literal).

Mention-search ranking (patched 2026-06-24): SQL-side `LEFT JOIN EntityAIMentionCount` with `ORDER BY count DESC, lastMentionedAt DESC NULLS LAST, label ASC, LIMIT ${take}`. Limit is applied AFTER the rank, so high-rank entities can no longer be missed by an alphabetical pre-cut. All search inputs ride as bound `Prisma.sql` parameters (no string interpolation — injection-safe).
Same backend is reused by the D.3 action picker (`AIChatActionPicker`) for the needs-picker fallback — DON'T fork the search route; extend `VALID_TYPES` instead if a new entity class is needed.

entryPoints.name: Assistant-message markdown renderer (D.1)
entryPoints.description: `AIChatMessageMarkdown` wraps `react-markdown` with `remark-gfm` (GFM tables, strikethrough, task lists) + `rehype-sanitize` (strip emitted HTML). The `code` override branches inline vs fenced; fenced routes to `AIChatCodeBlock`. The `pre` override returns a fragment to strip the wrapper because the code block owns its own chrome. User messages stay plain `<div whitespace-pre-wrap>` — only assistant turns get markdown.
knownTraps: `@tailwindcss/typography` is NOT installed. Dense chat typography uses Tailwind arbitrary selectors `[&_p]:my-1.5 [&_h1]:mt-3 ...` directly on the container div. DON'T reach for `prose prose-sm` — it won't apply.

Inline-vs-fenced detection: `inline ?? !langMatch`. The fallback `!langMatch` exists because some react-markdown setups omit the `inline` flag — relying on it alone produces fenced-block chrome on inline code.

Custom `pre` returns `<>{children}` (Fragment). Returning `
{children}
` would nest the highlighted code block inside another `
` and break Shiki's layout.

`threadContext` + `pageContext` are forwarded via CLOSURE inside the `code` override — no React Context provider. Markdown rendered outside the chat panel passes neither and the toolbar collapses gracefully to Copy-only.

entryPoints.name: Code block: Shiki + 3-action toolbar (D.1 + D.3)
entryPoints.description: `AIChatCodeBlock` renders fenced code with Shiki syntax highlighting (dynamic-imported on first mount; ~280KB module-singleton cost paid once per session). Toolbar always has a Copy button; when both `threadContext` and `pageContext` are provided, it ALSO renders three domain action buttons (Send to Worklog / Add to Job Notes / Save as Bullet) with per-button pending spinner and 1.8s 'Saved' success pill. Picker (`AIChatActionPicker`) opens when the resolver returns `needs-picker`.
knownTraps: `SUPPORTED_LANGS` is the EXACT list Shiki preloads — adding a language is a bundle-size trade-off. Unknown languages fall through to `plaintext` via `normalizeLanguage`, so `codeToHtml` never throws on unrecognized fences like ```mermaid.
Module-singleton `highlighterPromise` survives unmount/remount. First caller in a session pays the ~280KB cost; subsequent blocks reuse the cached promise. DON'T move into component-local state.

Theme switches between `github-dark` and `github-light` via `useTheme().resolvedTheme`. SSR users get `resolvedTheme === undefined` on first render → defaults to light. Acceptable flicker — the `useEffect` rerun on theme change repaints once hydrated.

ADR-0046 follow-up B (commit 6b06ddb): send-to-worklog is NO LONGER a short-circuit. The handler now reads `pageContext.activeWorklog?.id` and, when present, awaits `waitForEditor(activeId, 500)` from src/lib/worklog/editor-registry.ts. A note-kind handle triggers an in-page `handle.prepend(code)` (which writes WorkLogVersion.source='ai-prepend' via the editor's runSave); anything else (no active worklog, 500ms timeout, procedure kind, or prepend throws) falls through to the legacy `postAction(action, { content: code })` create-new POST. The fall-through path is intentionally indistinguishable from pre-follow-up-B behaviour so the toast UX stays consistent.

Errors are surfaced via sonner toasts (commit 407073c retrofit). For send-to-worklog: the in-page prepend path catches throws and falls through to the create-new POST without surfacing a duplicate error toast — the create-new branch is the single source of truth for user-visible status.

entryPoints.name: D.2 target resolver + 3 action routes
entryPoints.description: `resolveActionTarget(action, threadContext, pageContext)` applies fixed precedence: page ambient > thread mentions back-to-front > `{ kind: 'needs-picker', entityType }`. Three POST routes consume the resolved target: `/api/ai/actions/add-to-job-notes` (creates a `WorkHistoryNote` child row keyed by `workHistoryId` — additive journal entries, one row per click), `/api/ai/actions/save-as-bullet` (appends to `WorkHistory.accomplishments` JSON-array column with dedupe), `/api/ai/actions/send-to-worklog` (always creates new WorkLog v1).
knownTraps: `WorkHistory.notes` is a RELATION (`notes WorkHistoryNote[]`) — NOT a scalar column. The `add-to-job-notes` route MUST `prisma.workHistoryNote.create({ data: { workHistoryId, content } })`. The original v1 route did `prisma.workHistory.update({ data: { notes } })` and shipped because the unit test mocked Prisma without schema enforcement — Prisma threw `Unknown field 'notes'` at runtime against the real DB. Live smoke 2026-06-22 caught it; vitest mock-shape now mirrors schema-truth (mocks `workHistoryNote.create`, not `workHistory.update`).

save-as-bullet REUSES the existing `WorkHistory.accomplishments` `String?` column (designed as a JSON-array store) — there is NO `bullets` column anywhere. Parser accepts JSON array, JSON string, or freeform text. Dedupe via `existing.includes(content)` returns 200 no-op.

Resolver precedence is ambient > thread > picker, NOT the other way around. Ambient WINS even if the thread has a more recent matching mention. This is the deliberate ADR-0046 contract — don't 'fix' it without an ADR amendment.

Thread scan is back-to-front (most recent LAST in the array, scanned from end). `ai-chat.tsx` builds `recentMentions` by flattening user messages chronologically — preserve that ordering or the resolver picks the wrong target.
All 3 routes are owner-scoped (ADR-0028): cross-user entity IDs → 404, not 403. Don't leak existence.
send-to-worklog `deriveTitle` picks first non-empty trimmed line, caps at TITLE_MAX_LENGTH (80). Empty / whitespace-only content → 400; the route does NOT silently create a titleless note.

traversalRecipes.intent: Trace what happens from clicking 'Add to Job Notes' on a code block to the row update in the database.
steps: AIChatCodeBlock.handleAction(action). NOTE: send-to-worklog is now editor-aware (ADR-0046 follow-up B) — see traversal recipe 'how-does-ai-send-to-worklog-prepend-work' in the worklog-editor slice for that path. The steps below cover add-to-job-notes and save-as-bullet (which still use the resolver directly).
resolveActionTarget (src/lib/ai-chat-action-target.ts): ambient → thread → needs-picker.
Resolved branch: postAction POSTs `{ content, jobId }` to /api/ai/actions/<action>.
Picker branch: AIChatActionPicker opens, fetches /api/ai/mention-search, returns picked ref to handlePicked which POSTs.
Route handler validates auth + cross-user, performs the prisma update, returns the updated row.

traversalRecipes.intent: Understand the four context layers and how they compose the final messages array sent to the model.
steps: GET /api/ai/context returns slices (career-context chunks). `AIChat` renders them as removable chips; user can suppress via `suppressedSliceIds`.
AIChat.sendMessage concatenates unsuppressed slices into ONE system message, prepended to the messages array.
Slash command UX: input starting with `/` (no whitespace) opens menu; selected command's `prompt` field is sent verbatim as the user message via executeSlashCommand.
@-mentions: structured payload sidecar (`mentions`) ships alongside `messages`. Chat route increments EntityAIMentionCount and injects a hidden system message with the JSON block.
Ambient refs (D.2): NOT sent to the model — consumed client-side by the code-block action resolver only.

traversalRecipes.intent: Trace the SSE event flow from /api/ai/chat into the assistant message DOM.
steps: POST /api/ai/chat opens a stream. First event: `{ type: 'provider', provider }`.
AIChat.sendMessage reads the ReadableStream, decodes chunks, splits by `data: ` lines.
`text` events: `accumulated += event.text`, setMessages updates the assistant message content. Triggers AIChatMessageMarkdown re-render mid-stream.
`meta` event (final): hydrates AIMeta on the message, AIProvenanceChip renders in the header.
Stop button: `abortRef.current?.abort()` triggers AbortError in the read loop — swallowed silently in the catch.

traversalRecipes.intent: Trace how URL-aware ambient flows from the browser URL into the code-block action resolver.
steps: User navigates to /worklog/notes/abc123. next/navigation usePathname surfaces the new path inside useAiChatContext.
parsePathnameForAmbient("/worklog/notes/abc123") returns `{ activeWorklogId: "abc123" }` (the allowlist only matches /worklog/notes/[id] and /experience/[id], with /experience/verify reserved).
Hook builds URLSearchParams and fetches /api/ai/context?activeWorklogId=abc123. The fetch re-runs on every pathname change while `open` is true (deps: [open, activeWorklogId, activeJobId]).

Route handler reads the query params, runs `prisma.workLog.findFirst({ where: { id, userId, archivedAt: null } })` in PARALLEL with the existing recency heuristic, then prefers the URL hit (`urlWorklog ?? heuristicWorklog`).
Response carries `ambient.activeWorklog = { type: 'worklog', id, label }`. Hook drops it into `pageContext`.
AIChatCodeBlock receives `pageContext` via closure, passes it to `resolveActionTarget` on action click. Step (1) of precedence (ambient) now matches the URL, not the recency winner.

fileFingerprints.notes: Slim 281-LOC orchestrator after god-file refactor (commit 34a0f5c). Owns state + effects + hook composition + JSX shell only.

ADR-0046 follow-up B (commit 6b06ddb): send-to-worklog now tries waitForEditor(activeId, 500) before falling back to postAction. Editor-aware branch lives in handleAction's `if (action === 'send-to-worklog')` block. Toast retrofit (commit 407073c) still applies to both code paths.

URL-aware (follow-up D, commit 48db823): uses next/navigation usePathname + parsePathnameForAmbient to send activeWorklogId/activeJobId to /api/ai/context; refetches on every pathname change while open. Old `contextSlices.length > 0` once-only guard removed.
Path-B contract: accepts messages+setMessages as params, mirrors messages into messagesRef for stable sendMessage deps.
Exposes composable handleSlashKey returning boolean for the parent keydown handler to forward unconsumed events.
Exports SLASH_COMMANDS, TASK_OPTIONS, Message, ChatTask, ModelsData, ModelInfo (added 2026-06-23 for shared sibling-component model typing).

NEW in follow-up D (commit 48db823). Pure module: parsePathnameForAmbient(pathname) → { activeWorklogId?, activeJobId? }. Allowlist v1: /worklog/notes/[id] and /experience/[id], with RESERVED_EXPERIENCE_SEGMENTS (['verify']) skipped. 13 TDD specs in sibling .test.ts.

URL-aware (follow-up D, commit 48db823): accepts (request: Request), reads ?activeWorklogId= and ?activeJobId= from searchParams, runs userId-scoped Prisma overrides in parallel with the recency heuristic, prefers URL hit. Foreign ids fall back silently. Recency heuristic itself still NOT userId-scoped (pre-existing gap, tracked in slice traps).
